==Description==
The '''Soldier''' is a narrator that appears in [[Story Mode|Story]] mode.

He is the [[Soldier]] tower as a narrator.

==Appearance==
{{Tabber
|Current
|The '''Soldier''' takes the appearance of the Level 2 default [[Soldier]] tower. He has tan skin, a green shirt and cap, grey pants, dark grey shoes, grey knee-pads and thigh-pads, grey shades, headset and buckles.
|Version 1
|The '''Soldier''' takes the appearance of the Level 2 default [[Soldier]] tower. He has tan skin, a green shirt and cap, grey pants, dark grey shoes, grey knee-pads and thigh-pads, grey shades, headset and buckles.

However, unlike the regular [[Soldier]], it has destroyed clothes, which includes torn sleeves, destroyed shades, a broken cap and tilted headset. Dirt can also be seen on its face and the gloves normally seen on that upgrade are missing.
}}
